text:
anya: heads up  saw PII in debug logs from the mobile sample app during onboarding. quick repro in case it's useful:
1) `yarn start:mobile-debug`
2) complete signup flow on simulator
3) check device logs

anya: example line: ```2025-01-10T09:12:01.234Z DEBUG req=xyz789 user_email=alex@example.com event=\"signup:complete\"```
jamal: ahhh that should never reach stdout. our redact layer is supposed to run before any console or logger output.
maria: which SDK build? node-mobile or native-bridge? we've got slightly different OTEL hook ordering between the two.
anya: node-mobile bundle (index.native.js entry).
ryan: likely ordering issue: otel log hook registered after logger init so scrub never ran on the initial debug logs. iirc go/android wrappers run scrub earlier which is why they don't leak.
sec-jen: tagging sec here. do we know if the logs were shipped to remote sinks (sentry/otlp) or only local console?
anya: only local console in the simulator, but CI integration job reproduces it: integration/mobile-debug job shows scrub assertion failed.
ci-bot: build 3012 failed: integration/mobile-debug  see https://ci.redwood/3012 for details (assertion: no-email-in-output).
jamal: repro'd in a minimal repo. two possible fixes: (a) move redact middleware earlier during init, or (b) make scrub idempotent and wire it into a `console.*` shim so any direct console usage is sanitized.
ryan: also want parity tests: add unit tests for node-mobile to assert no `@` or `.com` in captured logs at DEBUG and INFO. add e2e that runs the signup flow and greps sanitized output.
maria: i'll draft a PR that does: 1) ensure otel/init runs before any logger helpers in `index.native.js`, 2) add a global `REDACT_DEBUG_LOGS` env toggle and default it to true in our CI/dev clusters, 3) add the tests in `integration/mobile-debug`
anya: can we gate the change behind a feature flag so internal dev clusters can still opt-out if needed?
sec-jen: yes require the flag to be true in prod and in the canary rollout. also file an incident and notify support if customers are affected.
jamal: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/mobile-sdk/pull/1012  includes logger init reorder + console shim + tests. requesting reviews from @maria and @ryan.
ryan: quick review done, left a comment about flaky sim timing on the e2e. otherwise LGTM. :thumbsup:
maria: merged to canary, kicking canary deploy to dev. monitoring scrub assertions and OTLP spans to ensure no PII leaks upstream.
ci-bot: added regression test `integration/mobile-debug/no-pii-in-debug`  passing locally and in CI smoke.
anya: thanks team. follow-up: update onboarding docs to explicitly say "initialize telemetry (otel hooks + redact) before any debug helpers or sample flows" so new devs don't accidentally log PII during local testing. :memo:
sec-jen: good catch. once canary looks green, ship hotfix to prod mobile images with `REDACT_DEBUG_LOGS=true` by default. also add a console warning if the flag is false in prod builds.
anya: closing loop. lesson: small init ordering differences across SDKs can cause PII leaks even when we have scrubbers in place.
